meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties to accelerate drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly evaluate ADMET and toxicity properties for many molecules

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 DeepChem 库处理化学分子数据：读取 SMILES/SDF/蛋白质序列，转换成多种数值特征，用传统 ML 或图神经网络训练模型，并用 MoleculeNet 基准评估或预测性质（如溶解度、毒性）。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理分子数据或预测分子性质（如溶解度、毒性），或提到要用 MoleculeNet 基准、图神经网络、预训练模型做化学机器学习时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude uses DeepChem to process molecular data: load SMILES/SDF/proteins, featurize into fingerprints/descriptors/graphs, train ML or GNN models, and evaluate or predict properties (solubility, toxicity) with MoleculeNet benchmarks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to handle molecular data, predict molecular properties (solubility, toxicity), or use MoleculeNet benchmarks, graph neural networks, or pretrained models for chemistry ML.

say_en.text: Use DeepChem to predict water solubility for this molecule.
say_en.note: Claude will load and predict via DeepChem.

say_en.text: Train a graph neural network on Tox21.
say_en.note: Claude will run a MoleculeNet benchmark training.

say_en.text: Fine-tune ChemBERTa on my CSV data.
say_en.note: Claude will start a transfer learning workflow.
